characters.continuity: Fraggle Rock (1983-1987 television series) and Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock (2022-present series)
characters.summary: Cotterpin Doozer is a young, creative, and stubborn Doozer who prefers architectural design and art over repetitive construction work. She uses small tools, planning, and teamwork to solve structural challenges.

techniques: Not established in the source; no attacks are documented

weaknesses: Small physical stature compared to Fraggles and Gorgs
Tiny Doozer size relative to Fraggles

depictions.title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock (2022-present series)

limitations: Limited reach and strength due to miniature Doozer biology
No combat role; her documented interests are art and design

sources.supports: Basic character background and Doozer society in Fraggle Rock

Cotterpin: young female Doozer, most frequently seen Doozer; passions are art and 'fun' rather than pure work; creative but stubborn and rebellious; rejected the helmet and ran away to become a Fraggle; Architect Doozer let her take the drawing board; in 'The Trial of Cotterpin Doozer' she had to prove Fraggles were noble and intelligent or lose her apprenticeship.

feats.claim: Won the drawing board (architect apprenticeship) instead of the traditional work helmet after defending her innovative designs.
feats.citation: Fraggle Rock episode 'The Trial of Cotterpin Doozer'

feats.claim: Won the drawing board (architect apprenticeship) instead of the work helmet, and defended it in 'The Trial of Cotterpin Doozer'.

unknowns: Full extent of engineering capabilities outside of standard Doozer architecture.
Combat utility against full-sized opponents is not established.
The source does not describe her building or inventing anything specific, so the inventor tag was removed.

characters.summary: Crazy Harry is an erratic pyrotechnic expert who delights in sudden explosions, detonating charges at unexpected moments, and responding enthusiastically to explosive-sounding words.
weaknesses: Prone to reckless collateral damage and accidental self-harm
limitations: Dependent on a supply of explosives and detonators
Explosions need set-up; no other combat skill is documented

sources.supports: Crazy Harry role and pyrotechnic character traits

Crazy Harry: 'the pyrotechnic expert on The Muppet Show'; 'delights in blowing things up'; asks 'Did somebody say bang?' before an explosion; played the explodaphone with Jean Stapleton (episode 306); in The Muppets uses explosives to carve his head into Mount Rushmore; sets off explosions in Muppets Most Wanted.

Muppet explosions: Crazy Harry sets off explosions in many productions; in Muppet Show: Sex and Violence he 'sets off an explosion when the Seven Deadly Sins are about to attack Nigel'; in episode 522 he answers a request for a bigger candle with 'a big stick of TNT'; several explosions throw the guest star onto the rafters.

feats.claim: Used explosives to carve his own likeness into Mount Rushmore.

sources.supports: Doc character details and setting in Fraggle Rock

Doc: inventor and only regular human character in Fraggle Rock; lives with Sprocket; inventions include the Rocket Sprocket and the Collapsible Bookcase; named Man of the Year by the North American Society of Tinkerers; friendship/rivalry with neighbour Ned Shimmelfinney; learns of Gobo late in the series ('The Honk of Honks').
